What to find: Standards, frameworks or regulations the model claims to follow (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001, AI Act Code of Practice).
Card sections that often contain it: Compliance, Responsibility, Safety

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card does not state that the model follows any standards, frameworks or regulations (such as ISO/IEC 42001 or the EU AI Act Code of Practice). It only recommends using Granite Guardian alongside the model to flag risks across dimensions in the IBM AI Risk Atlas.
quotes: To enhance safety in deployments, we recommend using Granite 4.2 alongside [Granite Guardian](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-guardian-4.1-8b) to detect and flag risks across key dimensions outlined in the IBM AI Risk Atlas.
